title: SEG Implementation Node
description: Schema for an Implementation node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Sourced from repo B (doxygen comment in .h + function body in .c). Authored by the Software Engineer. Discovered via @safety doxygen tag.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this implementation node. Form: {namespaceBase}/impl/{functionName}.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. No direct SPDX equivalent — maps to spdx:Artifact on SPDX export.

name.description: Function name. Used as the locator for the extractor. Must match the identifier in spdxId.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoB for all Implementation nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative paths within repo B to the source files for this function.

header.description: Relative path to the .h file containing the doxygen comment and @safety tag.

body.description: Relative path to the .c file containing the function body.
